test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: How much insurance cover is available for accidental death under the Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rs. 2 lakh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• PMSBY was launched on **May 9, 2015**, as part of the Government of India’s initiative to promote social security schemes.
 
• PMSBY is designed primarily for individuals in the age group of **18 to 70 years** who hold a bank account.
 
• The Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY) was launched by** Narendra Modi, the Prime Minister of India**.
 
• The scheme offers a sum insured of **₹2 lakh** in case of accidental death or total disability and **₹1 lakh** in case of partial disability.
